title: CodeFlow Adapter Protocol (CORE <-> Language Adapter, NDJSON over stdio)
$comment: Ticket 03. One JSON object per line. Root validates any single envelope: request | ok response | error response.
description: NDJSON envelope pair. NORMATIVE OPERATING CONTRACT (R11): (1) per-request timeout — CORE sends 'timeoutMs' inside params; the adapter MUST answer or the request fails E_TIMEOUT; (2) cancellation — params MAY carry 'cancellationToken' and CORE may send op 'shutdown' to drain; work observing a cancelled token returns E_CANCELLED; (3) maxMessageSizeBytes — envelopes above the negotiated size are rejected with E_BAD_REQUEST without parsing; (4) crash policy — a crashed adapter process is restarted ONCE per session; a second crash fails the flow with E_CRASHED; (5) backpressure — when the adapter's inbound queue exceeds its bound it responds E_BACKPRESSURE with retryable=true instead of buffering unboundedly; (6) version negotiation — the first exchange is always ping, whose ok result matches $defs.versionNegotiation {adapterVersion, protocolVersion}; a mismatching protocolVersion makes CORE stop with E_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION. Correlation rule: every response echoes the request 'id'; responses with unknown ids are dropped.

v.description: Protocol major version; integer 1 only. Anything else => E_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.

id.description: Request correlation id; echoed verbatim in the response.

params.description: Operation parameters. Conventionally includes timeoutMs (int > 0, normative), optional cancellationToken (string, normative), plus op-specific fields: detect {} ; harvest_candidates {repoRoot} ; slice {candidateId, entrySymbolPath, repoRoot} ; ping {} ; shutdown {}. Envelopes larger than maxMessageSizeBytes are rejected unread.

responseOkEnvelope.description: Success half of the correlation pair. For op ping the result object MUST match $defs.versionNegotiation.

err.description: Typed error codes only — free-form codes are contract violations. retryable=true expected for E_BACKPRESSURE and transient E_TIMEOUT; E_CRASHED after the single restart budget stays non-retryable for that flow.

adapterVersion.description: Adapter semantic version, pinned by core release (design §11.2).

versionNegotiation.description: Handshake payload returned as the ok result of ping.
